children: Parker-Hannifin completed $2.4 billion of U.S. senior notes and €2.025 billion of Euro senior notes offerings.
Issued $2.4B U.S. Notes across four tranches: $525M (2028), $500M (2029), $750M (2031), $625M (2033).
Issued €2.025B Euro Notes across three tranches: €700M (2030), €800M (2032), €525M (2036).
Proceeds, plus cash on hand, will repay borrowings under the 364-Day Term Loan used for the Filtration Group acquisition.
Notes are senior unsecured, subject to customary covenants, events of default and change-of-control purchase at 101%.
